title: A negative test with a high prior
hook: Two stated cases: explore the probability left after a negative result.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the probability left after a negative result affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the probability left after a negative result in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
